scope: Local UI/UX readiness fixes; not production or financial acceptance

build.configuration: Isolated Vite environment using mainnet-preview mode with explicit Devnet cluster, Mainnet disabled, development wallets disabled, same-origin read-only API proxy.

fixes.result: Pages and actions share the keyboard-selectable result list with tokens. Enter opens the selected page; reopening restores matches. Delayed token lookup preserves explicit keyboard selection.
Native modal dialog prevents focus entering obscured page content. Escape, close and guide links dismiss it, and focus returns to the actual trigger.
Navigation targets the visible launch route heading instead of the hidden legacy dialog heading.
Slow-loading and degraded-feature notices are visible. The fee-policy request times out after 15 seconds without enabling controls. Only a usable degraded app offers Continue with available features.

A first delayed creator result becomes keyboard-selectable; reopening retries a failed token lookup; page search navigates through the route-focus handler without disrupting existing sidebar handlers. Stale responses from earlier openings cannot replace current token results.

browser.label: mocked
browser.results: Final complete run: 32 passed on the final compiled Devnet preview, without retries. Three new desktop regressions were first reproduced against the prior build. An intermediate sidebar focus regression was corrected before this final run.
browser.fixtures: Approved default fee-policy fixture (revision 0); other API data unavailable; targeted in-memory token and creator fixtures; external requests blocked. No wallets or transactions.

syntax.method: The earlier pass parsed 1229 files with V8 SourceTextModule. This continuation separately ran node --check for src/features/workspace/navigation.js, src/app/startup/navigation.js and tests/smoke/navigation.spec.mjs. The final source-size check covered 1500 maintained files. This record does not claim a new full npm run check.
